source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue Direction A after the oriented Markov / Stern-Brocot bridge had merged. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT inspected the live accepted coverage and path APIs and selected the next roadmap step: determine how the oriented binary construction covers the full labelled positive Markov solution graph before quotienting coordinate symmetries. The submission proves that every non-backtracking move list from an oriented node has a unique Boolean path encoding, packages the three symmetric first-move branches out of the exceptional root (1,1,1), identifies the third branch with the already accepted sternNode representation, and proves that every positive Markov solution other than the root lies in one of those three oriented binary branches. The global theorem uses the accepted root reachability theorem, reduces an arbitrary move walk by cancelling adjacent equal involutions, and decodes the resulting non-backtracking tail through the oriented path API. No uniqueness of the branch representation, reached numerical Markov state, or Markov-number label is claimed. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
